title: Q-REDMAIN-revert-lane: the lane reverts or repairs a red main without a workflow edit
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** cmd:node --test seed/worker/test/sweeper.test.js
**Status:** open

Red main today is gated only by the deploy-site REDMAIN-1 check. Add to the tick Worker sweeper (seed/worker/src/sweeper.js) a pass that reads the latest main commit status, and when the gate is red for more than 15 minutes opens a revert PR of the offending squash commit through the git data API and merges it on green (regenerating generated files). Also wire the watchdog git-add list for ops/yearsim*, ops/saydo*, ops/trajectory* (workflow path, needs the executor surface).

size: M

**Closing probe:** `node --test seed/worker/test/sweeper.test.js` exits 0.
